description: tikajs-jmd0: a table on a page with /Rotate 90 whose text runs up the page (matrix 0 1 -1 0), so the page shows it upright: two columns, two text runs a row. ripstream grouped the runs by the baseline of the unrotated page, which is the column, and read the page a column at a time ('Alice', 'Paris', '42', then 'Name City Total'); Apache Tika 4.2.0 (/tika) reads the rows 'Name Alice', 'City Paris', 'Total 42'. Written by scripts/make-pdf-repros.ts.
